question: Mani starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards the west. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 13 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 19 km, takes a left turn and drives 4 km. He then takes left turn and drives 11 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to given condition :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/215b284d749fc658f6b5e249e30f9026139ea86d6dfdc2edb795803ef3de9267.png] 

**He drives 12 Km (13 - 5 = 8 + 4 Km ) in order to reach Point A from Point B**

**And he is towards the west direction **in order to reach Point A from Point B

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 4"**
